pageCache.text:
Welcome to Arden House
An independent co-educational day school for boys and girls, Years 7–11
Arden House
At Arden House, we believe that every young person deserves to be known, valued and challenged.
Why choose Arden House?
Choosing the right secondary school is about finding a place where your child will flourish not only academically but socially and personally too.
Our vision is to build an extraordinary school where academic ambition, social character and individual growth are given equal importance. Through small class sizes, exceptional teaching and meaningful relationships, we create an environment where every student is encouraged to think independently, embrace new challenges and discover their own strengths.
What makes Arden House truly distinctive is our belief that learning extends far beyond the classroom. Rooted in the vibrant and diverse community of West London, we use the world around us as a springboard for learning. Whether engaging with cultural institutions, local businesses or community organisations, our students develop curiosity, confidence and a deeper understanding of the world they will one day help shape.
Above all, Arden House is a community where every child is recognised as an individual. We celebrate each student's unique talents and aspirations, supporting them to become confident, articulate and compassionate young people who are prepared not only for academic success, but for life beyond school.
It is a privilege to lead a school where learning is purposeful, relationships matter and every student is inspired to become the very best version of themselves.
I look forward to welcoming you and your family.
Shirley Drummond
Key School Policies
Admissions
At Arden House, we believe every student should be known, valued and challenged to achieve their potential. With small classes, exceptional teaching and learning that extends beyond the classroom, we offer a deliberately different independent school experience.
Arrange a School Tour
The admissions process begins with a visit to Arden House. Parents are invited to arrange a school tour and meet our Headteacher, Shirley Drummond.
Meet the Headteacher
A meeting with Shirley provides an opportunity to discuss your child, their aspirations and whether Arden House is the right fit for them.
Entry Meeting
Following the initial visit, you will be invited to an entry meeting. We ask that the two most recent school reports are provided before this meeting.
Decision
Following the entry meeting, an acceptance or rejection letter will be sent to parents.
Fees & Registration
School fees are £8,000 inc VAT per term. If you wish to apply for a place, a non-refundable registration fee of £200 (including VAT) is payable alongside the completed registration form. Once a place is offered, a £400 deposit is required. This deposit is refundable. To begin your admissions journey, please contact us to arrange a school tour with our headteacher, Shirley Drummond.
